channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Why talks in Oman between Iran and Gulf Arab states were postponed
item.description: Hopes for a breakthrough on the Iran war have taken a hit after talks in Oman between Iran-Gulf nations were postponed.

item.title: US blocks Iran nuclear chief from attending key Vienna conference
item.description: Iran accuses US of pressuring Austria to revoke visa for Mohammad Eslami, calling it a violation of member state rights.

item.title: Israel probing Naza film on Gaza for treason, inciting anti-Semitism
item.description: Film alleges mass ⁠civilian deaths routinely built into military decisions amid Israel's genocidal war on Gaza.

item.title: What could stop the Houthis’ advance across Yemen?
item.description: Iran-backed group seized areas on Red Sea coastline.

item.title: Inside the Houthis’ expanding war economy in Yemen
item.description: The Houthis have restructured Yemen's commercial sector, securing billions in revenue amid a humanitarian crisis.

item.title: Austria denies entry to Iranian official after UN ruling
item.description: Iran accused Austria of reversing its approval of an Iranian delegation to the IAEA under external pressure.

item.title: Finland shelters under French nuclear umbrella amid Russian, US uncertainty
item.description: Finland becomes 10th European state to sign up to military cooperation and nuclear deterrence initiative.

item.title: Funerals for children killed after fire spreads to school in DR Congo
item.description: Memorial services were held for at least 28 children who were killed after a fire spread to their school in DR Congo.

item.title: NATO pledges more Ukraine support after Russia strikes near Poland
item.description: NATO chief Rutte insists Western allies will not be intimidated by Russian attacks meant to 'scare' them off.

item.title: Iran war reshapes Brics ties but also exposes divisions
item.description: Brics members agree they need a new global order but it's harder to answer what should replace it and how to get there.
